strings.Jaga 5 sistem — tubuh adalah universe-ny: Care for 5 systems — the body is your universe.
strings.Belum ada rekor. Selesaikan run pertamam: No records yet. Finish your first run!
strings.Fraksi menentukan dashboard, hero & pasu: Factions decide your dashboard, heroes & squad — same layout, different side.
strings.Pilih sel imun-mu. Yang terkunci bisa di: Pick your immune cell. Locked ones open via mission progress or buy in the Shop.
strings.Sang Tubuh sedang sakit — bersihkan orga: The Body is sick — cleanse the organs one by one with your immune squad!
The immune system remembers your sacrifice.
strings.Tonton video singkat untuk bangkit denga: Watch a short video to revive with 50% HP and clear nearby pathogens.
strings.Tubuh ini butuh dijaga. Pilih sistem yan: This body needs care. Pick the system to restore this run — gameplay stays the same, results differ.
strings.Tiap arena punya bonus berbeda. Terbuka: Each arena has a different bonus. Unlocked by how you play.
strings.Lab Pasukan — kuatkan hero & pasukanmu d: Squad Lab — empower heroes & squad with Antibodies.
strings.Pembayaran SIMULASI — tidak ada tagihan: SIMULATED payment — no real charge. Gateway ready to hook up to a PSP.
strings.Bagian lengkap! Buka Dashboard → kartu E: Full set! Open Dashboard → Evolution card → EVOLVE.
strings.Belum punya consumable — Serum Awal ters: No consumables yet — Starter Serum is available in the Shop.
strings.Kalahkan patogen untuk mengumpulkan bagi: Defeat pathogens to collect parts — elite enemies (Virions & Parasites) drop 5x more often, bosses always drop.
strings.Evolusi maksimal — Imun Legenda sejati!: Max evolution — a true Immune Legend!
strings.Jumlah pasukan bertambah tiap bab kampan: Squad grows with each campaign chapter cleared (max 6 cells)
strings.Serum Awal aktif: +25% damage run ini!: Starter Serum active: +25% damage this run!
strings.Sinyal sitokin! Semua nutrisi tertarik p: Cytokine signal! Every nutrient is pulled toward you.
strings.Daftar/masuk dulu agar pembelian & rekor: Sign up / log in first so purchases & records are saved to your account
Save reset. A new organism forms. 🧬
strings.Tarik di layar (atau W A S D) untuk berg: Drag on screen (or W A S D) to move!
strings.Tekan tombol TEMBAK! untuk menyerang pat: Press the FIRE! button to attack pathogens!
strings.Ambil nutrisi yang jatuh: itu XP & item: Grab falling nutrients: that's XP & evolution parts!
strings.Sel T sitotoksik standar garda depan. Me: Standard cytotoxic T cell on the front line. Fires cytokine granules that pierce rows of pathogens.
strings.Sel fagosit raksasa. Mencabik semua pato: Giant phagocyte. Shreds every nearby pathogen with sweeping 137° pseudopods.
strings.Neutrophil — penjaga pertama yang paling: Neutrophil — the fastest first responder. Rapid consecutive slashes; weak alone, hungry in numbers.
strings.Memproduksi antibodi penanda yang secara: Produces marker antibodies that automatically chase the nearest pathogen wherever it hides.
strings.Natural Killer cell hiperagresif. Tebasa: Hyperaggressive Natural Killer cell. High-speed toxic slashes with narrow reach and thin HP.
strings.Spesialis anti-parasit. Meluncurkan gran: Anti-parasite specialist. Fires toxic granules that chase pathogens automatically — 1.5× damage to Parasites.
strings.Patogen dasar pengejar. Bergerak lurus m: Basic chasing pathogen. Moves straight for the nearest immune cell.
strings.Dinding sel tebal satu lapis — butuh tep: A thick single-layer cell wall — it takes extra hits to crumble. Walks slow and never gives up.
strings.Virus berduri yang menginfeksi lalu peca: A spiky virus that infects then bursts — splits into 2 tiny virions when destroyed.
strings.Partikel virus kecil hasil pembelahan. C: A tiny virus particle born from splitting. Fast and fragile.
strings.Parasit berumbai yang bergerak zig-zag m: A fringed parasite zig-zagging across the bloodstream.
strings.Spora tebal berlapis kitin. Lambat tapi: A chitin-armored spore. Slow but very tough.
strings.BOS. Sel mutan raksasa yang lambat namun: BOSS. A giant mutant cell — slow yet nearly unkillable, periodically detonating cytotoxins around it.
strings.Protozoa bersilia yang bergerak zig-zag: A ciliated protozoan that weaves side to side — hard to hit in a straight line.
strings.Berlapis membran ganda — lapisan luarnya: Wrapped in a double membrane — the outer layer absorbs one hit. Peel the patch first!
strings.Genangan racun yang diam di tempat — mel: A still poison pool — it hurts anyone who dares cross. Destroy it from a distance!
strings.Kristal salah lipat yang nyaris kebal te: A misfolded crystal nearly immune to hits — slowly turning other enemies into crystal copies!
strings.Penyamar licin — nyaris tak terlihat kec: A slick mimic — nearly invisible unless spotlighted by NK Cells. Dangerous up close!
strings.BOS. Akumulasi racun sistemik yang menje: BOSS. Systemic poison buildup embodied as a giant spiky brute — flooding the arena with toxic pools.
strings.Orb nutrisi dasar — sumber XP utama dari: Basic nutrient orb — the main XP source from destroyed pathogens.
strings.Rantai protein padat — orb XP bernilai b: A dense protein chain — a high-value XP orb.
strings.Mata uang permanen. Dipakai untuk unlock: Permanent currency. Used to unlock heroes & squad upgrades.
strings.Sinyal kimia yang menarik SEMUA nutrisi: A chemical signal that pulls EVERY nutrient on the field toward you.
strings.Telur, daging, ikan. +20 HP maksimum sam: Eggs, meat, fish. +20 max HP until the run ends.
strings.Sinar matahari & ikan berlemak. Pulihkan: Sunlight & fatty fish. Restores 1.5 HP per second all run long.
strings.Ikan laut dalam. Racun sisa combat berku: Deep-sea fish. Clears 6 leftover combat toxin per run (meta).
strings.Bayam & daging merah. +10% damage selama: Spinach & red meat. +10% damage for 20 seconds — stronger than Zinc.
strings.Yogurt & makanan fermentasi. Cooldown se: Yogurt & fermented food. Attack cooldown -15% for 25 seconds.
strings.Sayur & buah berserat. Pencernaan lancar: Leafy greens & fibrous fruit. Smooth digestion: +25% XP for 30 seconds.
strings.Air putih. Pulihkan 0,8 HP/detik sepanja: Plain water. Restores 0.8 HP per second all run — small, even regen.
strings.+25% damage untuk 1 run berikutnya (dipa: +25% damage for the next run (auto-used when the run starts)
strings.+6% damage & +8% HP per level (khusus he: +6% damage & +8% HP per level (this hero only)
strings.Pasukan menembak +12% lebih sakit & +4%: Squad shoots +12% harder & moves +4% nimbler per level
strings.Tanpa fokus khusus — semua sistem +1 saa: No special focus — all systems +1 on a win
strings.Racun dibersihkan ekstra — selamatkan Li: Extra toxin cleanse — save the Lymphatic
strings.Bersihkan 40 patogen, lalu kalahkan Raja: Clear 40 pathogens, then defeat the Inflammation King
strings.Bersihkan 55 patogen, lalu kalahkan Ibu: Clear 55 pathogens, then defeat the Parasite Mother
strings.Bersihkan 70 patogen, lalu kalahkan Ratu: Clear 70 pathogens, then defeat the Sickle Queen
strings.Bersihkan 90 patogen, lalu kalahkan Jend: Clear 90 pathogens, then defeat the Cancer General
strings.Bersihkan 120 patogen, lalu kalahkan Raj: Clear 120 pathogens, then defeat the Cancer King
strings.Sisa permen yang tak berkehendak mengund: Stray candy invites plaque bacteria to dance on the teeth. The biological alarm rings — the first immune squad marches into the Mouth Cavity!
strings.Tiba-tiba perutmu kram — sesuatu yang bu: Your belly suddenly cramps — something rotten came in with the food! Viruses rage in the Stomach. The immune one rushes in with the squad to wipe them out.
strings.Para parasit menyusup ke Lorong Berliku: Parasites sneak into the Winding Passage of the Small Intestine and feast on nutrients. The body weakens — but the immune squad keeps growing.
strings.Angin kotor masuk — Paru-paru dipenuhi v: Dirty air pours in — the Lungs fill with sickle viruses that choke every breath. Behind the haze, the immune squad lines up to clear it, one by one.
strings.Kelenjar Limfe — markas besar pasukan im: The Lymph Nodes — the immune squad's own headquarters — have been infiltrated! Pathogens nest at home. The biggest battle starts here: cleanse the base!
strings.Di pusat tubuh, Raja Kanker mencoba meng: At the body's core, the Cancer King tries to seize the Life Axis. If it falls, everything ends. The entire immune squad — every cell, one goal: A CLEAN BODY!
strings.Ikuti cerita: bersihkan organ satu per s: Follow the story: cleanse organs one by one with your immune squad. Each chapter opens when the previous one is clear.
strings.Tanpa akhir + mutator harian. Uji sebera: Endless waves + daily mutators. See how long your squad lasts.
strings.Nutrisi jatuh +35% lebih banyak, musuh s: Nutrient drops +35%, enemies a bit tougher.
strings.Musuh +20% HP, tapi nutrisi memberi +30%: Enemies +20% HP, but nutrients give +30% XP.
strings.Player -15% kecepatan gerak, +25% jangka: Player -15% move speed, +25% nutrient pickup range.
strings.Di dalam tubuh... sesuatu yang asing men: Inside the body... something alien slipped in with the food.
strings.Virus dan bakteri berkeliaran — tubuh mu: Viruses and bacteria roam free — the body starts to ache.
strings.Tapi tubuh tidak sendirian. Pasukan imun: But the body is not alone. The immune squad rises — time for battle!
strings.Tapi perjalanan belum selesai — ada orga: The journey isn't over — other organs are still waiting for help...
strings.Tombol ini membawamu ke Peta Tubuh — per: This button opens the Body Map — a journey to cleanse sick organs, one by one.
strings.Pasukanmu: pilih sel imun yang dimainkan: Your squad: pick the immune cell you play. Every hero has a different shape & attack style.
strings.Tukar antibodi hasil battle jadi hero ba: Trade battle antibodies for new heroes, permanent upgrades & supplements.
strings.Consumable & hasil perang disimpan di si: Consumables & battle loot are stored here. Check it before the next battle.
strings.5 sistem tubuh (Sirkulasi, Pencernaan, S: 5 body systems (Circulation, Digestion, Nervous, Immune, Lymphatic). Toxin wears them down — winning runs restores them. Keep them healthy!
strings.Satu tubuh, dua pasukan. Buat akunmu — p: One body, two squads. Create your account — progress, hero levels & purchases stay safe under your name.
strings.Balikkan permainan — lumpuhkan tubuh dar: Flip the game — paralyze the body from within.
strings.Bersihkan organ dari patogen sampai SEHA: Cleanse organs of pathogens back to HEALTH
strings.Ganggu organ & lolos dari kejaran imun: Disrupt organs & escape the immune chase
strings.Pelindung tubuh — basmi patogen, pulihka: Body shield — crush pathogens, restore organs.
strings.Penembak presisi tim imun! Butiran sitok: Precision shooter of the immune squad! Its cytokine granules pierce a whole row of pathogens like magic arrows.
strings.Sel T sitotoksik mengenali antigen lewat: Cytotoxic T cells recognize antigen via their TCR, then destroy infected cells with perforin–granzyme granules.
strings.Pemakan raksasa! Ia melahap patogen sepe: The giant eater! It gobbles up pathogens like a hungry storybook monster.
strings.Makrofag adalah fagosit profesional: men: Macrophages are professional phagocytes: they swallow pathogens through phagocytosis and present their antigens to T cells (APCs).
strings.Pelari tercepat! Selalu yang pertama tib: Fastest runner! Always the first to arrive wherever there's a wound.
strings.Neutrofil adalah responder pertama infla: Neutrophils are the first responders of acute inflammation — the most abundant cells in blood, living only 1–2 days.
strings.Pabrik antibodi! Menembakkan penanda ber: Antibody factory! It fires Y-shaped markers at the enemy.
strings.Sel B memproduksi antibodi (imunoglobuli: B cells produce antibodies (immunoglobulins) that tag pathogens for destruction and build immune memory.
strings.Detektif galak! Menemukan musuh yang men: The tough detective! Finds disguised enemies and attacks without hesitation.
strings.Sel NK membunuh sel abnormal tanpa menun: NK cells kill abnormal cells without waiting for antigen activation — a first line of defense against cancer cells.
strings.Pemburu cacing! Granula toksiknya menger: Worm hunter! Its toxic granules swarm large parasites one after another.
strings.Eosinofil adalah spesialis parasit multi: Eosinophils specialize in multicellular parasites; their granules are toxic to helminths and also act in allergies.
strings.Penyusup kecil yang berjalan lurus menuj: A tiny invader marching straight toward your immune cells. Look out!
strings.Bakteri adalah organisme bersel satu tan: Bacteria are single-celled organisms without a nucleus (prokaryotes); some species cause infections and produce toxins.
strings.Bertegas tebal! Pelindungnya menyerap pu: Extra-thick armor! Its shield soaks up hits before its HP even feels it.
strings.Bakteri Gram positif punya dinding pepti: Gram-positive bacteria have a thick peptidoglycan wall — that's what turns purple in Gram staining.
strings.Pakai zirah ganda! Lapisan luarnya menye: Double-layer armor! Its outer coat absorbs your first slap.
strings.Bakteri Gram negatif punya membran luar: Gram-negative bacteria carry an extra outer membrane with LPS (endotoxin) shielding them from many attacks.
strings.Pencuri mesin! Menempel ke sel lalu meme: A machine thief! It clings to a cell and hijacks it to make copies of itself.
strings.Virus adalah parasit obligat — hanya ber: Viruses are obligate parasites — they replicate only by hijacking a host cell's machinery, then burst it (the lytic cycle).
strings.Bayi virus! Super cepat tapi rapuh sekal: A virus baby! Super fast but very fragile.
strings.Virion adalah partikel virus bebas: mate: A virion is a free virus particle: genetic material inside a protein capsid, ready to infect a new cell.
strings.Penghuni gelap! Hidup dengan mengambil m: A squatter in the dark! It lives off food taken from another body.
strings.Parasit hidup di dalam/di atas inang dan: Parasites live on or inside a host and drain its nutrients — their natural enemy is the eosinophil.
strings.Ketat seperti kapsul! Spora jamur bisa b: Tough as a capsule! Fungal spores can survive for a very long time.
strings.Spore fungi berdinding kitin sehingga ta: Fungal spores have chitin walls that resist harsh conditions; in the body, immune cells must dismantle them step by step.
strings.Sel pemberontak yang lupa aturan dan ter: A rebel cell that forgot the rules and keeps splitting non-stop!
strings.Sel kanker berasal dari sel tubuh sendir: Cancer cells arise from the body's own mutated cells — dividing uncontrollably and trying to dodge the immune system.
strings.Penari ulat! Bergoyang zig-zag supaya su: A wiggly dancer! It weaves side to side so it's hard to hit in a straight line.
strings.Protozoa adalah organisme eukariot berse: Protozoa are single-celled eukaryotes; many move using cilia or pseudopods.
strings.Lumpur licin! Jangan dipijak — permukaan: Slick slime! Don't step on it — it stings.
strings.Toksin bakteri merusak jaringan di sekit: Bacterial toxins damage nearby tissue; the lymphatic system is in charge of cleaning up the leftovers.
strings.Kristal salah susun! Bisa 'mengajari' pr: A misfolded crystal! It can 'teach' other proteins to fold wrong too.
strings.Prion adalah protein terlipat salah yang: A prion is a misfolded protein that induces other proteins to misfold — neurodegenerative diseases like BSE.
strings.Master penyamar! Pura-pura jadi sel seha: Master of disguise! It pretends to be a healthy cell until an NK Cell spotlights it.
strings.Sel abnormal menghindari deteksi imun (i: Abnormal cells avoid immune detection (immune evasion); NK and dendritic cells work to expose them.
strings.Raja genangan! Boss racun yang membanjir: King of puddles! A toxin boss flooding the arena with poisonous slime.
strings.Akumulasi racun sistemik melambangkan ke: Systemic toxin buildup represents poison spreading through the bloodstream when the lymphatic system is overwhelmed.
strings.Bahan bakar utama! Hampir semua sel suka: The main fuel! Almost every cell loves this sugar.
strings.Glukosa adalah sumber energi utama sel —: Glucose is the body's primary energy source — though excess sugar actually fuels inflammation.
strings.Balok bangunan protein! Rantai kecil pem: Protein building blocks! Little chains that construct the body.
strings.Asam amino menyusun protein tubuh; asam: Amino acids make up body proteins; essential amino acids can only come from food.
strings.Perisai jeruk! Menolong sel imun tetap b: The citrus shield! Helps immune cells stay strong and energetic.
strings.Vitamin C mendukung kerja fagosit dan pr: Vitamin C supports phagocyte function and collagen production; deficiency causes scurvy.
strings.Penanda huruf Y milik tim imun! Tempel k: The immune team's Y-shaped marker! Stick it on an enemy to call its destruction.
strings.Antibodi (IgG, IgM, IgA, dst.) menandai: Antibodies (IgG, IgM, IgA…) tag pathogens for phagocytes to eat; plasma B cells produce them.
strings.Peluit tim! Memanggil semua nutrisi berk: The team whistle! Calls every nutrient to gather around you.
strings.Sitokin adalah molekul sinyal komunikasi: Cytokines are immune signaling molecules — they direct cell movement, growth, and activation.
strings.Kacang kekuatan! Suplemen wajib agar sel: The strength nut! An essential boost to keep immune cells sharp.
strings.Zinc esensial untuk perkembangan neutrof: Zinc is essential for neutrophil and NK cell development; deficiency weakens immunity.
strings.Bata bangunan tubuh! Datang dari telur,: Body bricks! Comes from eggs, fish, and meat.
strings.Protein menyediakan asam amino untuk ant: Protein supplies amino acids for antibodies, cytokines, and tissue repair.
strings.Vitamin dari sinar matahari! Pembuat tul: The sunshine vitamin! A bone-strength builder.
strings.Vitamin D memodulasi imun bawaan & adapt: Vitamin D modulates innate & adaptive immunity; skin makes it when exposed to UVB light.
strings.Minyak ikan ajaib yang menenangkan perad: Magical fish oil that calms inflammation.
strings.Omega-3 bersifat anti-inflamasi dan memb: Omega-3s are anti-inflammatory and help resolve inflammation while supporting heart health.
strings.Bayam penguat darah! Membuat darah kuat: Spinach blood booster! Makes blood strong at carrying oxygen.
strings.Zat besi membentuk hemoglobin; kurang →: Iron builds hemoglobin; deficiency causes anemia and weak immunity. The body even 'hides' iron from pathogens!
strings.Teman baik dari yogurt! Penjaga perut ba: A good friend from yogurt! Keeper of a happy belly.
strings.Probiotik adalah bakteri baik usus; seki: Probiotics are gut-friendly bacteria; about 70% of immune tissue lives in the gut (GALT).
The intestine broom! Keeps digestion running smoothly.
strings.Serat melancarkan pencernaan dan jadi ma: Fiber keeps digestion moving and feeds good bacteria (prebiotics).
strings.Penyeimbang segalanya! Air adalah jalan: The balancer of everything! Water is the highway immune cells travel on.
strings.Hidrasi menjaga volume darah dan limfa —: Hydration maintains blood and lymph volume — the transport network for immune cells.
strings.Jalan raya darah! Mengantar oksigen dan: The blood highway! Delivers oxygen and immune squads all over the body.
strings.Sistem kardiovaskular memompa darah (jan: The cardiovascular system pumps blood (about 100,000 heartbeats a day) — distributing nutrients, oxygen, and immune cells.
strings.Pabrik pengubah makanan jadi energi!: The factory that turns food into energy!
strings.Traktus pencernaan memecah makanan jadi: The digestive tract breaks food into nutrients; 70% of the body's immune tissue lives in the gut (GALT).
strings.Kabel telegraf tubuh! Pesan berjalan sec: The body's telegraph wires! Messages travel lightning fast.
strings.Sistem saraf (otak & saraf tepi) mengend: The nervous system (brain & peripheral nerves) controls the body; neuro-immune communication shapes immune responses.
strings.Pasukan penjaga! Sel-sel hebat yang meli: The guardian squad! Amazing cells that protect the body from germs.
strings.Sistem imun membedakan 'diri vs asing':: The immune system tells 'self vs foreign': innate (fast) and adaptive (specific + memory) branches.
strings.Selokan pembersih tubuh! Menampung dan m: The body's cleaning drains! Collects and filters fluid.
strings.Sistem limfatik mengembalikan cairan jar: The lymphatic system returns tissue fluid to blood; lymph nodes are filtration & lymphocyte activation posts.
strings.Gerbang makanan! Petualangan semua rasa: The food gateway! Every flavor adventure starts here.
strings.Enzim amilase di mulut mulai mencerna pa: Salivary amylase starts digesting starch; leftover sweets feed plaque bacteria and cause cavities.
strings.Mesin peras asam! Membunuh kuman yang ik: The acid squeeze machine! Kills germs that came with your food.
strings.Asam lambung (pH 1,5–3,5) mematikan seba: Stomach acid (pH 1.5–3.5) kills most pathogens — H. pylori is famous for surviving there anyway.
strings.Jalur panjang penyerap makanan! Berkelok: The long food-absorbing route! Winding like a maze garden.
strings.Villi usus memperluas permukaan serapan;: Intestinal villi expand absorption surface; the gut also hosts trillions of friendly microbes (the microbiome).
strings.Balon udara hidup! Tempat oksigen dituka: Living balloons! Where oxygen is traded for carbon dioxide.
strings.±480 juta alveolus adalah tempat difusi: About 480 million alveoli are where gas diffusion happens; tiny cilia sweep dust and germs out.
strings.Markas besar pasukan imun! Pos centang p: The immune squad's headquarters! A checkpoint for germ hunters.
strings.Kelenjar limfe memfiltrasi limfa — lokas: Lymph nodes filter lymph — the place where lymphocytes meet antigens and launch responses.
strings.Pompa keajaiban yang tak pernah tidur!: The miracle pump that never sleeps!
strings.Jantung memompa ±5 liter darah per menit: The heart pumps about 5 liters of blood per minute — the center of circulation and a dangerous gateway for systemic pathogens.
strings.Tarik perhatian musuh di sekitar lalu be: Taunt nearby enemies, then brace yourself.
strings.Melahap mangsa terdekat: damage besar +: Devour the nearest prey: big damage + restore 30 HP.
strings.Tandai musuh terdekat: menerima +20% dam: Mark the nearest enemy: it takes +20% damage for 6s.
strings.Pulihkan 15 HP untukmu & pasukan di seki: Restore 15 HP for you and nearby squad.
strings.5 serangan kilat beruntun ke target terd: 5 lightning-fast strikes at the nearest target.
Poison dart: damage + poison for 4 seconds.
strings.Tombak pemburu: damage besar 6× ke 1 mus: Hunter spear: massive 6× damage to 1 enemy.
strings.Awan histamin: damage kecil + musuh lamb: Histamine cloud: small damage + slows enemies 40%.
strings.Badai kimia luas: damage 3× + lambat 5 d: Wide chemical storm: 3× damage + slow for 5s.
A sting that slows the target.
strings.Damage 3× — atau 8× bila HP target di ba: 3× damage — or 8× if target HP is below 20%.
25 HP shield for you and nearby allies.
A perfected strike from the dark: 2.5×.
Vanish and reappear ahead of your movement.

rules.replace: $1 antibodies collected (brought home when the run ends)

rules.replace: Evolve to $1 ($2) — unlock new abilities & forms!
Immune squad: $1 cells join the fight!$2
The immune squad arrives. Cleanse the $1 completely!
